purpose: the only accepted shape for an AI interpretation of one station brief; validated by scripts/check_miami_ai_output.py before any output is reviewed or published

items.fact_ids: array of fact ids from the brief, at least one

each.drivers: array of {statement, fact_ids}, at least one
each.rule_result_ids: array, must include the station's RC-03 result for that scenario and the station's RC-07 result

items.question: string
items.related_ids: array of fact ids, rule result ids or kb refs (may be empty)

items.rule_result_id: must exist in the rules package

rule_explanations.written_by: Agent 2 of the Coze V2 workflow

fields.gis_objects_package: must equal the current gis_objects package id
fields.g1: the GIS reader's object_readings, patterns, candidate_sites, data_anomalies, not_determinable (object ids and .Gnnn fact ids must exist)
fields.g2: the heat and residents reader's readings; auxiliary_only must be true

spatial_evidence.written_by: gis-verify; heat and zoning are read together and are auxiliary evidence; the checker also reports how often G1 agrees with the rule-based role hints

workflow.written_by: the output gate code node; an output whose gates did not both pass is never saved as a run

fields.run_id: string or null; only a platform-returned id, never invented
fields.retrieval_hits: array of {kb_doc, section} as reported by the platform (may be empty)

citation_rules.fact_id: ^MIA-MM-[0-9]{2}\.F[0-9]{3}$ and must exist in the station's brief
citation_rules.rule_result_id: ^(MIA-MM-[0-9]{2}|NET)\|(low|medium|high|-)\|RC-[0-9]{2}$ and must exist in the rules package
citation_rules.kb_ref: ^KB_V2_0[1-6] §(DS|CM|IG|OI|GR|LG)-[0-9]{2}$ and must exist in the knowledge base documents
citation_rules.object_id: <station>.RDnn | .RLnn | .GW01 | .ZN<FID> | .LU<code> | .PCnnn | .HC<row>_<col> | .BG<geoid>, and .Gnnn for code-computed summary facts; must exist in the current gis_objects package

publication_rule: an output is exported to the web page only when the checker passes and run_record.review.status is reviewed_ok or reviewed_with_edits; example outputs (execution_mode example_not_a_model_output) are never exported
